messages:
Maria C: Thinking about the policy DSL for routing + quota grace windows. We need a simple way for product to say: free tier -> prefer cpu-cheap variants, allow 30s per-tenant grace when QuotaExceeded before falling back to global model. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Kevin L: I like an explicit `grace_window` field. default 0s, pluggable by tier. Example: `grace_window: 30s` in the policy. Keeps runtime simple.

Asha R: +1. UX question: do we expose this as seconds in the Console or a human-friendly dropdown (30s / 1m / 5m)? Product prefers dropdown for safety.

Liam P: From runtime side, grace window implies we keep tokens in-flight and queue short requests for that tenant. Need to cap queue depth per-tenant or we risk mem blow. Suggest `max_queued_requests_per_tenant`.

Kevin L: Agreed. Maybe policy DSL looks like this in YAML:```yaml
policy:
  tier: free
  prefer_variants: [gpt-small-quant, gpt-small-fp16]
  fallback: [gpt-medium]
  grace_window: 30s
  max_queued_requests_per_tenant: 5
  quota_behavior: "soft_fail_then_fallback"
```

Maria C: Nice. How should `quota_behavior` values map to telemetry? We want to surface when a tenant hits grace vs hard deny.

telemetry-bot: new metric suggestion: `routing.quota_event{tenant, tier, region, behavior}` with tags `grace_entered`, `grace_expired`, `hard_denied`, `fell_back`.

Asha R: That metric would let Console show a small timeline on each tenant detail page. UX: mark the period when grace was active (shaded).

Kevin L: Implementation note: if `grace_window` is non-zero, runtime must emit `grace_entered` at t0 and `grace_expired` at t0+grace if no capacity freed. If fallback triggered earlier, emit `fell_back` and clear `grace_entered`.

Liam P: Edge case: region-affinity. If tenant prefers region A and fallback goes to region B, we need to record `region_mismatch=true` on the event so billing/latency dashboards can filter.

Maria C: Good call. Also product asked about per-route overrides (e.g., embeddings get different grace than generation). Should be allowed but default to tier-level.

Kevin L: DSL extension: allow `routes:` map with overrides. Example snippet:```yaml
policy:
  tier: pro
  grace_window: 10s
  routes:
    /v1/embeddings:
      grace_window: 60s
      prefer_variants: [embed-small]
```

Asha R: Console UX: show a summary card: Tier defaults + per-route overrides (+ edit button). Keep advanced section collapsed.

Liam P: Need a migration plan for existing policies. Suggest runtime fallback: if `routes` absent, behave as before. Warn in audit logs when non-default behavior used.

Maria C: Action items: Kevin to draft API shape and version bump, Liam to add queue cap and region_mismatch tags, Asha to mock Console dropdowns and example copy, telemetry-bot to add metric stub. I'll sync with product tomorrow. :+1:

Kevin L: I'll open RFC PR with schema and a few unit tests for grace logic.

telemetry-bot: ticket created: RMT-4621 (routing: quota grace telemetry)

Asha R: Mock links: https://figma.redwood/mock/grace-windows (preview)

Liam P: Noted. Also adding a runtime flag to disable queueing per-tenant for emergency ops.

Maria C: Great thread. Quick Q: do we want to allow fractional seconds? probably not, keep integers.

Kevin L: yep, ints only. keeps things simpler across languages.

Asha R: cool. Meeting in #eng-platform-sync Friday to finalize UX + API.

Maria C: Thanks everyone.
